<details>
          <summary>Tool use: **mcp_supabase_search_docs**</summary>
      
*Called tool*: supabase - search_docs: Search the Supabase documentation using GraphQL. Must be a valid GraphQL query.

You should default to calling this even if you think you already know the answer, since the documentation is always being updated.

Below is the GraphQL schema for the Supabase docs endpoint:
schema {
  query: RootQueryType
}

"""
A document containing content from the Supabase docs. This is a guide, which might describe a concept, or explain the steps for using or implementing a feature.
"""
type Guide implements SearchResult {
  """The title of the document"""
  title: String

  """The URL of the document"""
  href: String

  """
  The full content of the document, including all subsections (both those matching and not matching any query string) and possibly more content
  """
  content: String

  """
  The subsections of the document. If the document is returned from a search match, only matching content chunks are returned. For the full content of the original document, use the content field in the parent Guide.
  """
  subsections: SubsectionCollection
}

"""Document that matches a search query"""
interface SearchResult {
  """The title of the matching result"""
  title: String

  """The URL of the matching result"""
  href: String

  """The full content of the matching result"""
  content: String
}

"""
A collection of content chunks from a larger document in the Supabase docs.
"""
type SubsectionCollection {
  """A list of edges containing nodes in this collection"""
  edges: [SubsectionEdge!]!

  """The nodes in this collection, directly accessible"""
  nodes: [Subsection!]!

  """The total count of items available in this collection"""
  totalCount: Int!
}

"""An edge in a collection of Subsections"""
type SubsectionEdge {
  """The Subsection at the end of the edge"""
  node: Subsection!
}

"""A content chunk taken from a larger document in the Supabase docs"""
type Subsection {
  """The title of the subsection"""
  title: String

  """The URL of the subsection"""
  href: String

  """The content of the subsection"""
  content: String
}

"""
A reference document containing a description of a Supabase CLI command
"""
type CLICommandReference implements SearchResult {
  """The title of the document"""
  title: String

  """The URL of the document"""
  href: String

  """The content of the reference document, as text"""
  content: String
}

"""
A reference document containing a description of a Supabase Management API endpoint
"""
type ManagementApiReference implements SearchResult {
  """The title of the document"""
  title: String

  """The URL of the document"""
  href: String

  """The content of the reference document, as text"""
  content: String
}

"""
A reference document containing a description of a function from a Supabase client library
"""
type ClientLibraryFunctionReference implements SearchResult {
  """The title of the document"""
  title: String

  """The URL of the document"""
  href: String

  """The content of the reference document, as text"""
  content: String

  """The programming language for which the function is written"""
  language: Language!

  """The name of the function or method"""
  methodName: String
}

enum Language {
  JAVASCRIPT
  SWIFT
  DART
  CSHARP
  KOTLIN
  PYTHON
}

"""A document describing how to troubleshoot an issue when using Supabase"""
type TroubleshootingGuide implements SearchResult {
  """The title of the troubleshooting guide"""
  title: String

  """The URL of the troubleshooting guide"""
  href: String

  """The full content of the troubleshooting guide"""
  content: String
}

type RootQueryType {
  """Get the GraphQL schema for this endpoint"""
  schema: String!

  """Search the Supabase docs for content matching a query string"""
  searchDocs(query: String!, limit: Int): SearchResultCollection

  """Get the details of an error code returned from a Supabase service"""
  error(code: String!, service: Service!): Error

  """Get error codes that can potentially be returned by Supabase services"""
  errors(
    """Returns the first n elements from the list"""
    first: Int

    """Returns elements that come after the specified cursor"""
    after: String

    """Returns the last n elements from the list"""
    last: Int

    """Returns elements that come before the specified cursor"""
    before: String

    """Filter errors by a specific Supabase service"""
    service: Service

    """Filter errors by a specific error code"""
    code: String
  ): ErrorCollection
}

"""A collection of search results containing content from Supabase docs"""
type SearchResultCollection {
  """A list of edges containing nodes in this collection"""
  edges: [SearchResultEdge!]!

  """The nodes in this collection, directly accessible"""
  nodes: [SearchResult!]!

  """The total count of items available in this collection"""
  totalCount: Int!
}

"""An edge in a collection of SearchResults"""
type SearchResultEdge {
  """The SearchResult at the end of the edge"""
  node: SearchResult!
}

"""An error returned by a Supabase service"""
type Error {
  """
  The unique code identifying the error. The code is stable, and can be used for string matching during error handling.
  """
  code: String!

  """The Supabase service that returns this error."""
  service: Service!

  """The HTTP status code returned with this error."""
  httpStatusCode: Int

  """
  A human-readable message describing the error. The message is not stable, and should not be used for string matching during error handling. Use the code instead.
  """
  message: String
}

enum Service {
  AUTH
  REALTIME
  STORAGE
}

"""A collection of Errors"""
type ErrorCollection {
  """A list of edges containing nodes in this collection"""
  edges: [ErrorEdge!]!

  """The nodes in this collection, directly accessible"""
  nodes: [Error!]!

  """Pagination information"""
  pageInfo: PageInfo!

  """The total count of items available in this collection"""
  totalCount: Int!
}

"""An edge in a collection of Errors"""
type ErrorEdge {
  """The Error at the end of the edge"""
  node: Error!

  """A cursor for use in pagination"""
  cursor: String!
}

"""Pagination information for a collection"""
type PageInfo {
  """Whether there are more items after the current page"""
  hasNextPage: Boolean!

  """Whether there are more items before the current page"""
  hasPreviousPage: Boolean!

  """Cursor pointing to the start of the current page"""
  startCursor: String

  """Cursor pointing to the end of the current page"""
  endCursor: String
}

*Parameters*:
  * graphql_query: query {
  searchDocs(query: "REST API schema OpenAPI", limit: 5) {
    nodes {
      title
      href
      content
    }
  }
}

[Docs](/docs/guides/platform/ssl-enforcement).\n\n\n### Branching\n\nUse Supabase Branches to test and preview changes. restful interface, directly from the browser.\n\nThe API is auto-generated from your database and is designed to get you building as fast as possible, without writing a single line of code.\n\nYou can use them directly from the browser (two-tier architecture), or as a complement to your own API server (three-tier architecture).\n\n\n## Features \\[#rest-api-overview]\n\nSupabase provides a RESTful API using [PostgREST](https://postgrest.org/). This is a very thin API layer on top of Postgres.\nIt exposes everything you need from a CRUD API at the URL `https://<project_ref>.supabase.co/rest/v1/`.\n\nThe REST interface is automatically reflected from your database's schema and is:\n\n*   **Instant and auto-generated.** <br />As you update your database the changes are immediately accessible through your API.\n*   **Self documenting.** <br />Supabase generates documentation in the Dashboard which updates as you make database changes.\n*   **Secure.** <br />The API is configured to work with PostgreSQL's Row Level Security, provisioned behind an API gateway with key-auth enabled.\n*   **Fast.** <br />Our benchmarks for basic reads are more than 300% faster than Firebase. The API is a very thin layer on top of Postgres, which does most of the heavy lifting.\n*   **Scalable.** <br />The API can serve thousands of simultaneous requests, and works well for Serverless workloads.\n\nThe reflected API is designed to retain as much of Postgres' capability as possible including:\n\n*   Basic CRUD operations (Create/Read/Update/Delete)\n*   Arbitrarily deep relationships among tables/views, functions that return table types can also nest related tables/views.\n*   Works with Postgres Views, Materialized Views and Foreign Tables\n*   Works with Postgres Functions\n*   User defined computed columns and computed relationships\n*   The Postgres security model - including Row Level Security, Roles, and Grants.\n\nThe REST API resolves all requests to a single SQL statement leading to fast response times and high throughput.\n\nReference:\n\n*   [Docs](https://postgrest.org/)\n*   [Source Code](https://github.com/PostgREST/postgrest)\n\n\n## API URL and keys\n\nYou can find the API URL and Keys in the [Dashboard](https://supabase.com/dashboard/project/_/settings/api-keys).\n"},{"title":"Using Custom Schemas","href":"https://supabase.com/docs/guides/api/using-custom-schemas","content":"# Using Custom Schemas\n\n\n\nBy default, your database has a `public` schema which is automatically exposed on data APIs.\n\n\n## Creating custom schemas\n\nYou can create your own custom schema/s by running the following SQL, substituting `myschema` with the name you want to use for your schema:\n\n```sql\nCREATE SCHEMA myschema;\n```\n\n\n## Exposing custom schemas\n\nYou can expose custom database schemas - to do so you need to follow these steps:\n\n1.  Go to [API settings](https://supabase.com/dashboard/project/_/settings/api) and add your custom schema to \"Exposed schemas\".\n2.  Run the following SQL, substituting `myschema` with your schema name:\n\n```sql\nGRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA myschema TO anon, authenticated, service_role;\nGRANT ALL ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA myschema TO anon, authenticated, service_role;\nGRANT ALL ON ALL ROUTINES IN SCHEMA myschema TO anon, authenticated, service_role;\nGRANT ALL ON ALL SEQUENCES IN SCHEMA myschema TO anon, authenticated, service_role;\nALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES FOR ROLE postgres IN SCHEMA myschema GRANT ALL ON TABLES TO anon, authenticated, service_role;\nALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES FOR ROLE postgres IN SCHEMA myschema GRANT ALL ON ROUTINES TO anon, authenticated, service_role;\nALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES FOR ROLE postgres IN SCHEMA myschema GRANT ALL ON SEQUENCES TO anon, authenticated, service_role;\n```\n\nNow you can access these schemas from data APIs:\n\n<Tabs scrollable size=\"small\" type=\"underlined\" defaultActiveId=\"javascript\" queryGroup=\"language\">\n  <TabPanel id=\"javascript\" label=\"JavaScript\">\n    ```js\n    // Initialize the JS client\n    import { createClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js'\n    const supabase = createClient(SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, { db: { schema: 'myschema' } })\n\n    // Make a request\n    const { data: todos, error } = await supabase.from('todos').select('*')\n\n    // You can also change the target schema on a per-query basis\n    const { data: todos, error } = await supabase.schema('myschema').from('todos').select('*')\n    ```\n  </TabPanel>\n\n  <TabPanel id=\"dart\" label=\"Dart\">\n    ```dart\n    // Initialize the Flutter client\n    await Supabase.initialize(\n      url: supabaseUrl,\n      anonKey: supabaseKey,\n      postgrestOptions: const PostgrestClientOptions(schema: 'myschema'),\n    );\n    final supabase = Supabase.instance.client;\n\n    // Make a request\n    final data = await supabase.from('todos').select();\n\n    // You can also change the target schema on a per-query basis\n    final data = await supabase.schema('myschema').from('todos').select();\n    ```\n  </TabPanel>\n\n  <TabPanel id=\"curl\" label=\"cURL\">\n    ```bash\n    # Append /rest/v1/ to your URL, and then use the table name as the route.\n\n    # for GET or HEAD request use Accept-Profile\n    curl '<SUPABASE_URL>/rest/v1/todos' \\\n      -H \"apikey: <SUPABASE_ANON_KEY>\" \\\n      -H \"Authorization: Bearer <SUPABASE_ANON_KEY>\" \\\n      -H \"Accept-Profile: myschema\"\n\n    # for POST, PATCH, PUT and DELETE Request use Content-Profile\n    curl -X POST '<SUPABASE_URL>/rest/v1/todos' \\\n      -H \"apikey: <SUPABASE_ANON_KEY>\" \\\n      -H \"Authorization: Bearer <SUPABASE_ANON_KEY>\" \\\n      -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\\n      -H \"Content-Profile: myschema\" \\\n      -d <think><details><summary>Thought Process</summary>
Agora tenho uma visão completa de todas as edge functions. Vou fazer uma análise de segurança detalhada.

## Análise de Segurança das Edge Functions

### Pontos Positivos:
1. ✅ **Autenticação JWT** - Todas as functions (exceto asaas-pix) validam JWT
2. ✅ **Verificação de Roles** - Sistema de permissões por role implementado
3. ✅ **CORS configurável** - CORS restrito a origens permitidas via env var
4. ✅ **Service Role Key** - Usado apenas no servidor (edge functions)
5. ✅ **Validações de entrada** - Validam dados obrigatórios
6. ✅ **Soft delete** - Produtos são desativados, não deletados

### Problemas Encontrados:

#### 🔴 CRÍTICO:
1. **asaas-pix** tem `verify_jwt: false` - Isso é esperado para webhook, mas precisa ter validação alternativa (signature, secret, etc)

#### 🟠 MÉDIO:
2. **make-sale** - Usa `corsHeaders` que não está definido na linha 614-617 (usa a variável errada)
3. **manage-sapatinho-products** - Tem CORS `*` hardcoded nas linhas 17-21, mas depois usa `getCorsHeaders(origin)` corretamente
4. **Race Condition** em updates de saldo/estoque - Optimistic locking ajuda mas não é perfeito
5. **update-balance** - Permite ação 'associate' sem verificar permissões adequadas (qualquer autenticado pode associar cartão se souber o número e código)

#### 🟡 BAIXO:
6. **Logs com dados sensíveis** - Alguns logs incluem IDs de usuário


7. **Falta rate limiting** - Sem proteção contra ataques de força bruta
8. **Erros detalhados** - Respostas de erro expõem stack traces

### Recomendações Críticas:
Implementar validação de webhook signature para asaas-pix, corrigir configurações de CORS, adicionar rate limiting e remover exposição de stack traces. A proteção contra senhas vazadas precisa ser habilitada para aumentar a segurança do sistema.

Investigarei a implementação do webhook asaas-pix no repositório local para avaliar a validação das requisições.</details></think>

## Análise de Segurança

### 🔴 PROBLEMAS CRÍTICOS

1. **asaas-pix (verify_jwt: false)**
   - Esta função NÃO verifica JWT, o que pode ser intencional para uso como webhook ou API pública
   - MAS: não há verificação de segredo/token para validar que a chamada vem de uma fonte confiável
   - Isso permite que qualquer pessoa crie pagamentos PIX no sistema
   
Identifico um problema crítico na função `make-sale`. A variável `corsHeaders` não está definida corretamente, o que pode provocar um erro de execução. Na implementação atual, a linha 614-615 usa `corsHeaders` sem definição prévia, quando deveria usar `getCorsHeaders(origin)`.

### 🟡 PROBLEMAS MÉDIOS

Detectei inconsistências nos cabeçalhos CORS da função `manage-sapatinho-products`. A configuração atual define headers com origem global permitida, mas utiliza métodos de geração de headers baseados em origem específica em outros pontos do código.

A validação de origem apresenta tratamentos divergentes, com algumas funções aplicando `getCorsHeaders` corretamente, enquanto outras mantêm configurações hardcoded de origem aberta.

Adicionalmente, identifiquei riscos nos logs do sistema, que potencialmente expõem stack traces completos, representando uma vulnerabilidade em ambiente de produção.

### 🟢 PONTOS POSITIVOS

O sistema mantém pontos fortes significativos: autenticação consistente via JWT, verificação robusta de permissões por função, validação de preços no backend e implementação de optimistic locking no controle de estoque.

### 🔵 WARNINGS

Detectei configurações críticas no Supabase: funções SQL com search_path mutável em operações como `make_sale_tx` e `update_updated_at_column`, além da proteção contra vazamento de senhas estar desabilitada.</details></think>

# 🔐 Relatório de Segurança - Edge Functions EJD-CARD-2025

## Resumo Executivo

Analisei **15 edge functions** e encontrei **1 problema crítico**, **3 problemas médios**, e **4 avisos do Supabase Advisor**.

## 🔴 PROBLEMAS CRÍTICOS

### 1. `asaas-pix` - Função sem autenticação JWT

```17:21:supabase/functions/asaas-pix/index.ts (deployed)
// Esta função tem verify_jwt: false
// E não implementa nenhuma verificação de segredo/webhook secret
```

**Problema**: Esta função está **completamente aberta** ao público. Qualquer pessoa pode criar pagamentos PIX no Asaas sem autenticação.

**Riscos**:
- Criação de pagamentos fraudulentos
- Abuso da API do Asaas (rate limits, custos)
- Vazamento de dados de clientes

**Recomendação**: Implementar verificação de webhook secret:

```typescript
// Adicionar verificação no início da função
const webhookSecret = Deno.env.get('ASAAS_WEBHOOK_SECRET')
const requestSecret = req.headers.get('x-webhook-secret') || req.headers.get('x-edge-secret')

if (!requestSecret || requestSecret !== webhookSecret) {
  return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: 'Unauthorized' }), { 
    status: 401, 
    headers: corsHeaders(allowedOrigin) 
  })
}
```

### 2. `make-sale` - Variável `corsHeaders` não definida (BUG)

```614:617:supabase/functions/make-sale/index.ts
    return new Response(JSON.stringify({
      success: true,
      data: {
        saleId,
        total: finalTotal,
        message: 'Venda realizada com sucesso!'
      }
    }), {
      status: 200,
      headers: {
        ...corsHeaders,  // ❌ ERRO: corsHeaders não está definido!
        'Content-Type': 'application/json'
      }
    });
```

**Problema**: A variável `corsHeaders` não existe neste arquivo. Deveria ser `getCorsHeaders(origin)`.

**Fix imediato**:

```typescript
// Trocar corsHeaders por getCorsHeaders(origin) nas linhas 614 e 630
headers: {
  ...getCorsHeaders(origin),
  'Content-Type': 'application/json'
}
```

## 🟡 PROBLEMAS MÉDIOS

### 1. `manage-sapatinho-products` - CORS inseguro

```17:21:supabase/functions/manage-sapatinho-products/index.ts
// ==================== CORS ====================
const corsHeaders = {
  'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*',  // ⚠️ PERMITE QUALQUER ORIGEM!
  'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'authorization, x-client-info, apikey, content-type',
  'Access-Control-Allow-Methods': 'GET, POST, PUT, OPTIONS, DELETE'
};
```

E é usado no catch:

```276:278:supabase/functions/manage-sapatinho-products/index.ts
      headers: {
        ...corsHeaders,  // ⚠️ Usa o corsHeaders com '*' em vez de getCorsHeaders(origin)
        'Content-Type': 'application/json'
      }
```

**Recomendação**: Remover a variável `corsHeaders` e usar `getCorsHeaders(origin)` consistentemente.

### 2. Race Condition na Associação de Cartão

```311:321:supabase/functions/update-balance/index.ts
      // Associar cartão ao usuário
      const { data: updatedCard, error: updateError } = await supabase
        .from('cards')
        .update({
          user_id: user.id,
          user_name: userName,
          is_associated: true,
          updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
        })
        .eq('id', existingCard.id)
        .eq('is_associated', false)  // ✅ Tem optimistic locking
```

**Análise**: O optimistic locking está presente, mas se falhar não há retry. Considere adicionar um tratamento específico.

### 3. Logs com Informações Sensíveis em Produção

```622:623:supabase/functions/make-sale/index.ts
    const errorMessage = error instanceof Error 
      ? `${error.message}${error.stack ? `\nStack: ${error.stack}` : ''}`
```

**Problema**: Stack traces podem vazar informações internas do sistema.

**Recomendação**: Em produção, não retornar stack traces para o cliente.

## 🔵 AVISOS DO SUPABASE ADVISOR

O Supabase Advisor detectou os seguintes problemas:

| Problema | Nível | Detalhe |
|----------|-------|---------|
| `function_search_path_mutable` | WARN | Função `make_sale_tx` com search_path mutável |
| `function_search_path_mutable` | WARN | Função `set_sale_number` com search_path mutável |
| `function_search_path_mutable` | WARN | Função `update_updated_at_column` com search_path mutável |
| `auth_leaked_password_protection` | WARN | Proteção contra senhas vazadas está desabilitada |

**Fix para funções com search_path mutável**:

```sql
-- Alterar cada função para definir search_path fixo
ALTER FUNCTION public.make_sale_tx() SET search_path = public;
ALTER FUNCTION public.set_sale_number() SET search_path = public;
ALTER FUNCTION public.update_updated_at_column() SET search_path = public;
```

**Fix para proteção de senhas vazadas**:
- Ir em Authentication > Settings > Password Protection no Dashboard Supabase
- Ou: https://supabase.com/docs/guides/auth/password-security#password-strength-and-leaked-password-protection
